phase: Phase 30: Fleet Mesh Congestion Control & Adaptive PHY Switching

stories.title: Dynamic BLE Advertising Interval Throttler & Flooding Redundancy Governor
stories.description: Implement MeshCongestionController.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/ providing pure Kotlin mesh congestion estimation, adaptive advertisement throttling (20ms–250ms), and probabilistic rebroadcast suppression under high node density with zero Java dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Computes local channel density metric based on unique node beacons heard per 5-second epoch
Dynamically scales advertising interval from 20ms (sparse) up to 250ms (dense > 12 nodes)
Applies probabilistic relay suppression for non-critical telemetry frames to eliminate broadcast storms

stories.title: Adaptive Multi-PHY Switcher Engine (LE 1M, LE 2M, LE Coded S8)
stories.description: Implement AdaptivePhyManager.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/ to negotiate and select optimal Bluetooth 5.0 PHY layers based on moving RSSI and link distance. Transitions between LE 2M (high throughput, close range), LE 1M (standard), and LE Coded S8 (long-range canyon mode).
acceptanceCriteria: Negotiates LE 2M when peer RSSI > -65 dBm for high-speed burst throughput
Switches to LE Coded S8 when peer RSSI < -85 dBm to extend link reach up to 500m+
Implements 4-second hysteresis to prevent PHY oscillation during cornering

stories.title: Hardware Bridge Multi-PHY Binding & Tactical Cockpit RF Pill Telemetry
stories.description: Integrate MeshCongestionController and AdaptivePhyManager into IntercomHardwareBridge.kt, AndroidPlatformBridge.kt, and IntercomBridge.kt (iOS Swift). Expose active PHY mode (1M / 2M / CODED) and channel airtime utilization percentage to MainCockpitScreen.kt and TactileDiagnosticsSheet.kt.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposes reactive ActivePhyState with typed CancellationHandle to iOS Swift bridge
Displays RF PHY pill (2M / 1M / CODED) in Tactical Cockpit HUD with color coding
Exposes live channel airtime contention percentage in Diagnostics Sheet
Compiles without warnings across Android and iOS targets

stories.title: 24-Node High-Density RF Congestion Simulation & Range Benchmark Test
stories.description: Create CongestionSimulationTest.kt validating a 24-node convoy operating in tight cluster and high-speed highway stretch. Simulates high-density RF collision, verifies dynamic advertisement throttling, zero dropped Emergency SOS broadcasts, and automatic fallback to LE Coded S8.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 24 nodes broadcasting simultaneous voice and telemetry frames
Verifies total channel collision reduction > 40% when CongestionController is enabled
100% Emergency SOS packet delivery rate within 250ms under heavy congestion
All tests pass cleanly in ./gradlew test
